headline_of_the_week.title: Evvy closes $40M Series B for precision women's health
headline_of_the_week.summary: Priyanka Jain, co-founder and CEO of Evvy, closed a $40M Series B led by Catalio Capital Management on September 15, taking total funding to $65M. Evvy will scale EvvyAI diagnostics across fertility, preterm birth, cervical cancer, endometriosis and PCOS, starting with a fertility-first push into 3,000 practitioner offices.

headlines.title: Evvy raises $40M Series B led by Catalio Capital Management
headlines.summary: Founder Priyanka Jain closed a $40M Series B for precision women's-health diagnostics platform Evvy. New backers include US Fertility Innovation Fund, Rethink Impact, Muse Capital and Alumni Ventures. First stop: fertility across 3,000 practitioner offices.

headlines.title: Highstock lands $30M Series A from a16z
headlines.summary: Camille van Horne's NYC luxury-resale infrastructure startup Highstock closed a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz on September 14, taking total equity to $35.5M since 2024. Rare late-2024-cohort female-founder Series A led by a top-tier fund.

headlines.title: FE+MALE Swiss report: 14.1% of 2024 funded Swiss startups had a female founder
headlines.summary: Startupticker published the FE+MALE report on September 11: only 14.1 percent of Swiss startups that raised a 2024 round had at least one female founder. The report frames three concrete interventions: visibility, capital access, and mentor networks.

headlines.title: MENA female founders took 0.14% of H1 2026 VC dollars, $2.5M of $1.7B
headlines.summary: Fortune reported that female-founded MENA startups took just $2.5M of the $1.7B deployed across 242 rounds in H1 2026 per Wamda. In August alone, male-founded teams took 96 percent-plus of the $375M regional total.

headlines.title: Boundless Futures Foundation crosses $1.5M in lifetime grants with $300K to 6 women founders
headlines.summary: On September 17, the Foundation announced $50,000 EmpowHer grants each to Accelidea (Rose Huang), Enspired Solutions (Denise Kay), RIES (Megan Graham), Rif Care (Valerie Emanuel and Rebecca Caputo), ShopConsciously (Mpho Hansjee) and Tikal Industries (Tayyaba Ali). Foundation now past $1.5M lifetime deployed since 2023.
